forgotAskAdmin: Ask another admin to reset it in Settings → Users. You will get a temporary password and choose a new one when you sign in.
forgotNoAdmin: If no admin can sign in, an admin password can be reset on the computer that runs OpenVision:
forgotStep1: On that computer, open a terminal in the OpenVision folder.
forgotStep2: Type {command} with the admin's username, then press Enter.
forgotStep3: Sign in here with the temporary password it shows, then choose a new password.
forgotNote: Patients and exams are not changed. The reset is recorded in the audit log.
demoIntro: This install still has the fictional demo accounts with their public password. All demo data is made up.
demoWarn: Before real use, an admin should deactivate these accounts or change their passwords (Settings → Users). This box then disappears.
setupIntro: No one can sign in yet. Create the first administrator account. You can add providers and technicians afterwards in Settings → Users.
setupLanguageHint: The practice's default language. Each user can choose their own in My settings.
usernameHint: 3-32 letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores.
displayNameHint: Shown in the header and on records, e.g. "Office Manager".
codeSetHint: ICD-10-CM turns on US code suggestions (CPT visit and test codes to copy into your billing system; OpenVision does not create bills); ICD-11 leaves them off. Both can be changed later in Settings → Practice.
